headline: Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon files case over harassment in Venice
summary: The actress spent three hours at a police station to file a complaint against those identified in videos of the attack.
details: Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon has filed a legal case in Venice, Italy, against individuals who harassed and attacked her on Monday night.
On Tuesday, she spent approximately three hours at the Piazza Le Roma police station to complete the filing process.
Badhon stated on her verified Facebook page that she would not leave Venice without filing the case, emphasizing her resolve to seek justice.
A delegation from the Milan Consulate was present to provide support during the filing of the complaint.
The case has been filed against all individuals who were visible in the videos of the incident.
Following the attack, Italian police ensured her safety by escorting her to a secure location.
The incident has sparked discussions in the Bangladesh Parliament, where the Speaker described the attack as an 'unpardonable and condemnable crime'.
caption:
Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon refuses to leave Venice without filing a case against those who harassed her.

Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon has filed a legal case in Venice, Italy, against individuals who harassed and attacked her on Monday night.

On Tuesday, she spent approximately three hours at the Piazza Le Roma police station to complete the filing process.

Badhon stated on her verified Facebook page that she would not leave Venice without filing the case, emphasizing her resolve to seek justice.

A delegation from the Milan Consulate was present to provide support during the filing of the complaint.

The case has been filed against all individuals who were visible in the videos of the incident.

Following the attack, Italian police ensured her safety by escorting her to a secure location.

The incident has sparked discussions in the Bangladesh Parliament, where the Speaker described the attack as an 'unpardonable and condemnable crime'.

#AjmeriHaqueBadhon #Venice #Bangladesh #Justice #EntertainmentNews

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo

headline: 9 deaths: Dengue toll hits highest daily peak this year
summary: A surge in cases has led to 1,571 hospitalizations in 24 hours, prompting the government to launch a 3-month special prevention campaign.
details: Nine people died from dengue in a single day, marking the highest daily death toll recorded so far this year.
The health crisis has intensified with 1,571 patients being admitted to hospitals within a 24-hour window, the highest number of admissions in a single day this year.
In response to the rising numbers, the government has initiated a three-month special program focused on dengue prevention and control.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is set to launch this campaign on Saturday to combat the spread of the virus.
The Prime Minister has urged students and citizens to take an active role in keeping their homes and schools clean to eliminate mosquito breeding grounds.
caption:
9 deaths in one day. 1,571 hospitalizations. Dengue is hitting a record peak this year.

Nine people died from dengue in a single day, marking the highest daily death toll recorded so far this year.

The health crisis has intensified with 1,571 patients being admitted to hospitals within a 24-hour window, the highest number of admissions in a single day this year.

In response to the rising numbers, the government has initiated a three-month special program focused on dengue prevention and control.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is set to launch this campaign on Saturday to combat the spread of the virus.

The Prime Minister has urged students and citizens to take an active role in keeping their homes and schools clean to eliminate mosquito breeding grounds.
